sources.text: PDO covers fresh (brined, not ripened, almost no rind) and a cured version (at least 2 months, thin smooth rind); Murciano-Granadina goat

facts.v: Milk only from registered herds of the Murciano-Granadina goat breed, grazing scrub and coarse pasture
Fresh type grilled or used in desserts and salads; cured type sliced as a snack or served with a meal
